conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const b = $json['Birthday  ']; if (!b) return null; const parts = b.split('/'); return parts[0].padStart(2,'0') + '/' + parts[1].padStart(2,'0'); })() }}
conditions.rightValue: ={{ (() => { const d = new Date($now); return String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0') + '/' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); })() }}
